phase: research8 convergence engine on the daily panel: enter when an option is cheap (or rich) against the stock-only fair value, re-evaluate fair value every session, exit on convergence or a stop
written_before_any_result: 2026-10-03, after downloading research8-daily-2026-10 and while the protocol_daily pipeline was building; no quote-based result from this release had been computed or seen
data: research8-daily-2026-10 (SPY + 40 names, every session 2016-2025, expiries <= 120 days, strikes 0.7-1.3 x close), research8 stock panel, research7 release dates
contract: At each session and name: the listed expiry with 21-45 calendar days left nearest 30; ATM straddle (strike nearest spot with both sides quoted); each leg bid > 0, mid >= 0.05, open interest >= 10, (ask - bid)/mid <= 0.25. Cash dividend ex-date before expiry excludes single names (SPY allowed). Once entered, the same contracts are followed.
fair_value: phase 1 HAR_FHS_shrunk (walk-forward, refit each 1 January from earlier data: original names through 2021, all names after) forecast of the log total return from the current close to the expiry close, centred so E[S_T] = S; fair = E[|S_T - K|]. Recomputed every session from data up to that close.

signals.percentile: rank of today's rho among the same name's rho values on its previous 252 sessions with a candidate straddle (needs >= 60)

entry.edge_gate_variant: additionally buy only if fair >= ask + fees per share; sell only if bid >= fair + fees per share

exit.target_full: long: bid >= current fair; short: ask <= current fair
exit.target_half: long: bid >= entry mid + 50% of the initial gap (fair0 - mid0); short mirrored
exit.event_guard: close at the session before any release session of the name
exit.expiry_guard: close when 5 or fewer sessions remain to expiry
exit.missing_quote: if either leg is unquoted on a session, conditions are checked at the next quoted session; the trade is dropped and counted if no quote exists before expiry

position_rule: one open position per name and rule; a new entry only after the previous trade has closed
hedge: variants hedged (daily delta hedge at stock closes with entry-IV Black-Scholes deltas, 2 bp of traded notional) and unhedged
rules: direction {buy_cheap, sell_rich} x entry {percentile, percentile + edge gate} x target {full, half} x max_hold {5, 10} x hedge {hedged, unhedged} = 32 rules
returns: P&L per share / entry mid, at three execution levels: mid (primary), 25% of the quoted half-spread at entry and exit, and full bid/ask. Fees $0.65 per contract per side reported separately.
attribution: per trade (entry-mid units, signed by direction): initial gap; convergence captured = change in (mid - fair); fair-value drift = change in fair; hedge P&L; spreads; fees; hedge cost; exit reason; sessions held. Reported as means per rule so the source of any loss is visible.
statistics: weekly series by entry week (inactive weeks 0); Sharpe x sqrt(52); weekly-clustered t; hit rate; SPY and single names reported separately as diagnostics
samples: dev: entries 2016-01-01 to 2021-12-31 with exits by 2021-12-31; test: entries from 2022-01-03
freeze_rule: Eligible on dev at the 25%-spread level: >= 150 trades, weekly t >= 3.0, Sharpe > 0.8, positive mean in 2016-2018 and 2019-2021. Freeze at most 3 by Sharpe, at most one per (direction, hedge).
test_gates: Strong at the 25%-spread level: weekly t >= 2.0, Sharpe >= 1.0, positive mean at full bid/ask, positive in at least 3 of the 4 test years 2022-2025. Every rule is also logged in research8/trials.jsonl.
clarification_2026_10_03: Before any result: at the user's request the universe is SPY plus the 10 most liquid panel names (order of research8_phase2/liquid50.json) instead of all 41, for speed; results widen to more names only if a rule is worth confirming.
